name: zmodel_render_node_hardware
description: zModel hardware node renderer prepares DI geometry, dispatches point entries, and submits flat no-UV polygons through the hardware callbacks.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S remains open because no accepted VC COFF byte comparison exists for this large renderer.

Current targeted coverage exercises the point-entry dispatch and the flat no-UV hardware submit path. Textured, lit, attribute, clip-alt, and cycle-update branches remain covered through reconstructed dependencies and need a later source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja identifies 0x477b30 as zModel::RenderNodeHardware with no current function or address warnings, and the dependency frontier reports source dependencies satisfied with no visible source blockers at depth 1.

Native smoke zmodel_render_node_hardware_flat_smoke verifies the no-UV flat hardware path copies and projects a DI triangle, applies material color/alpha/render parameters, and calls g_zVideo_pfnSubmitPolyFlatColor16 with the expected queue mode.

Native smoke zmodel_render_node_hardware_point_smoke verifies the renderer's flags-and-pointEntries branch dispatches a point entry through zModel_RenderPointQueueEntry, calls g_zVideo_pfnDrawPointColor16 with the packed color, applies depth bias, and queues the lens flare sample.
